dogecoin.text: The New SHIB coin. Who let the dogs out? Woof, Woof, Woof Woof. Dogecoin was a joke? It was, but was the joke played on you? DOGE moved from under .000018 cent, to .51cents.Those that was in, made massive cash. Money, Money, Money, Money. Yup, you would be singing now also.

@coingecko The New SHIB INU coin. Who let the dogs out? Woof, Woof, Woof Woof. They said that Dogecoin was a joke? DOGE moved from under .00018 cent, to .51 cents. Now, was you in on that trade or did you fall for the joke? I was in and money, money, money, money. You would be singing, too.
